name: Meme Maker
description: Classic memes with bold outlined text on your own photo or a ready made background. Drag the text, change size and colour, save it.
prompt: A meme maker with top and bottom text in bold outlined capitals over my photo or a ready made emoji background, draggable text, text size and colour, and a few classic templates.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Memes clásicos con texto grande con borde sobre tu foto o un fondo ya hecho. Arrastra el texto, cambia tamaño y color, y guárdalo.
